verses.1: Let us, then, the strong ones, not try to handle those weak things; let us not even like it ourselves.
verses.2: Let each of us who is nearby be willing to do what’s right in relation to the construction work.
verses.3: For Christ did not choose Him for Himself alone; rather, as it is written, “The proud have fallen upon Me.”
verses.4: For everything that was written, it was written for today’s teachings. This is so that we can have hope through patience and by reflecting on these writings.
verses.5: But the God of patience and perseverance will give you the same guidance to act together in accordance with Christ Jesus.
verses.6: So that you may praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ with one mouth.
verses.7: Therefore, let you both be united with each other, just as Christ also united you with Himself for the glory of God.
verses.8: For I say that Christ became a servant of God for the sake of true religion, so that he might fulfill the messages of his fathers.
verses.9: And let the nations praise God for His righteousness. As it is written: “Therefore I will confess to you in the nations, and by your name I will praise you.”
verses.10: And again he says: “May you be blessed, nations, along with their people.”
verses.11: And once again: Praise be to Him, O all nations! All the people praised Him.
verses.12: And again, Esaias says: “It will be the root of Jesse; and he will rule over nations. Nations will hope in him.”
verses.13: But the God of hope will reward you with joy and peace in your faith. He will also strengthen you in your hope, through the power of His holy spirit.
verses.14: I also, brothers, am convinced that you are all people of goodness. You possess complete knowledge, and you are capable of informing each other.
verses.15: I have written to you more boldly, in order to remind you of this. Because of the grace that God has given me.
verses.16: To serve as a minister of Christ Jesus to all nations, to preach the gospel of God, so that the offerings of the nations may be acceptable and blessed by the Holy Spirit.
verses.17: I therefore have the glory in Christ Jesus, before God.
verses.18: For I do not dare speak about those things which Christ did not accomplish through me forever among the nations, both in word and in deed.
verses.19: With the power of signs and wonders, with the power of the Spirit. Thus, from Jerusalem and its surrounding areas, the gospel of Christ was spread throughout all places.
verses.20: However, it is not in that way that one should preach the Good News, since Christ was called “Christ.” This is so that I might not build a foundation on another basis.
verses.21: But as it is written: Those who have not been informed about him will not be able to see him, and those who have not heard of him will not be able to join in his celebration.
verses.22: Therefore, I have postponed many of my visits to you.
verses.23: Now, they no longer have a place in these regions. They also have the intention to come to you from time to time.
verses.24: As I proceed towards Spain, I hope that by traveling there, I will be able to reach you and convey my thoughts to you from there, if I ever get to see you first.
verses.25: Now, I am going to Jerusalem to serve the saints.
verses.26: For Macedonia and Achaea were able to establish a certain relationship with the poor people among those who were holy in Jerusalem.
verses.27: They were indeed desirable, and they are also useful. For when they were passed down to the spiritual beings, they were also useful in their physical functions.
verses.28: After doing this, and after sealing that fruit for them, I will leave through you to go to Scythia.
verses.29: I know that, as I come to you with the gifts of Christ’s grace, I am bringing them with me.
verses.30: I beg you, brothers, to join me in my prayers for me, through our Lord Jesus Christ, and through the love of the Holy Spirit.
verses.31: So that I may be able to serve among the Jews, and that my duty in Jerusalem will become acceptable to the saints.
verses.32: So that I may come to you in joy, by the will of God, so that I can comfort you.
verses.33: And the God of peace will be with you all, amen.
